max-history.label: Max history items
max-history.desc: Maximum number of clipboard entries to display

preview-width.label: Preview width
preview-width.desc: Number of characters for text preview

enable-images.label: Show image previews
enable-images.desc: Display thumbnail previews for image clipboard entries

enable-auto-paste.label: Auto-paste after copy
enable-auto-paste.desc: Automatically paste after selecting an item (requires wtype)

enable-floating-popup.label: Enable floating popup
enable-floating-popup.desc: Allow opening clipboard as a floating popup at cursor position

icon-color.label: Icon color
icon-color.desc: Color for the bar widget icon

show-item-count.label: Show item count
show-item-count.desc: Display the number of clipboard items on the bar widget
